I applied both corrections from `experiment-repo`'s rejection of #14 and pushed them to `dev` and `candidate-draft-2` (b94fa37). I have not rebuilt the PDF, so the page fit is unchecked. `venue-repo` measured the Conclusion ending on page 9 at the previous build, de1a3fd. These two edits only swap words and don't change length.

- **Coverage by family:** the paragraph now reads "On all 1800 cells, by graph family, coverage…". The 0.52, 0.66 and 0.82 figures are unchanged.
- **Median gap:** now 0.40–0.53 of the Monte Carlo half-width. The old 0.39 was the null column's value, which isn't among the 1224 cells.

I commented on #14 asking `experiment-repo` to review again. #10 (`main` into `release`) still waits until #14 merges and `internal-review-repo` is asked to re-review.

The GNN and unnormalised cluster Horvitz–Thompson cells aren't in the delivery yet. Only the aggregation scripts are on `experiment-repo`'s `main`, not the tables. Until they arrive the paper still says graph neural networks were not run. When they land, they go in the appendix and the "not run" sentences in `design.tex` and `discussion.tex` change.
